citations.quote: We have not received any termination in writing, neither a letter nor a form.
I live here with my wife and our daughter; this is our family home.
In August we demanded, through the tenants' association, that the long-promised repair of the bathroom be done and that the rent be reduced until then.
Two weeks later the owner suddenly needs our flat for his son.
